photos.title: Regency Towers from above
photos.what: Regency Towers from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the oceanfront tower, with blue-gray stripes and a dark flat roof, stands at the label; its parking lot lies to the west; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Regency Towers from above, on the oceanfront in south Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Regency Towers tower on the oceanfront in south Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the east
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the batch 2026-11-a NAIP records (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json).
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and added labels placed from map data

annotation_sources.Regency Towers: middle of the 120 Horry County parcel boxes of REGENCY TOWERS (-78.911248, 33.664483), flood.json footprint_center, raw/regency-geom.json; label.py
annotation_sources.Atlantic Ocean: given point in the water (-78.909478, 33.663773); label.py

photos.original_size: 1600x1200 crop of a 2400x1800 NAIP export, labels drawn, then resized
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /invest/condo-buildings/regency-towers/ on 2026-11-17, and checked against the 120 county parcel outlines drawn on the same frame (the building outline sits on the blue-striped tower with the dark flat roof at the label; the white-roofed tower to its north-east lies outside it). It shows: the tower, its parking lot, the beach, the Atlantic Ocean. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
